scope_notes: Real remote HTTP transfers through a temporary HTTPS relay; body bytes exclude HTTP/TLS/IP/TCP overhead, retransmissions and relay traffic.
Operation CPU is sender process only; cpu_subtotal_us adds reported receiver-handler CPU per observation, excluding HTTP-server/network/TLS/relay work.
Exchange wall includes serialization, request waiting, handler and durability; not pure byte send time and not additive to operation wall.
Remote verification_us is client post-ack identity work; exact bytes were checked separately after receiver stop and reopen.
Nearest-rank p95 for three observations is the observed maximum, not a qualified population-tail estimate.
Nine paired inputs with deterministic rotating arm order; pilot dose only, not randomized 30-trial WAN acceptance.
Conventional adaptive uses the checkpoint base, not a previously transferred full trace.
Independent analysis joins exact-read receipts but does not itself repeat physical transfers or receiver reads.
Generated/edited data are model-derived; unrelated control and unsuccessful prediction CPU remain included.
